title: Complete geomantic calculation registers: one figure key constrained by transposition and parity
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. One complete historical program, not a local geomantic motif: four input figures generate four transposed figures and seven parity-derived figures. Joint constraints can in principle identify argument values under a shared unknown figure key. The accessible full primary text is late (Turner1655, pseudo-Agrippa); an early complete rule/meaning witness and an independently bounded complete target register remain missing. A sixteen-figure fixed-code account covering the GDT882 certificate lines is already impossible by its rank20 result. No target query, target image or decoder.

design.mechanism: Conditional narrow-register law: every admitted complete target record contains exactly fifteen complete figure tokens in one externally fixed register order. A single injective whole-token map maps each observed written form to F_2^4; no position-dependent keys, omitted fields, homophones or added prose are allowed. The first four are free inputs. Put these four column vectors in M. The next four are columns of transpose(M). Positions9..12 are XOR of pairs(1,2),(3,4),(5,6),(7,8); positions13,14 are XOR(9,10),XOR(11,12); position15 is XOR(13,14). This is an explicit mathematical formalization of the common procedure in the consulted source, not a claim that every historical geomantic tradition uses exactly this order or fifteen positions.
design.unit: A complete fifteen-field calculation, including all inputs and all intermediate outputs, is the sole proposed unit. Every independently nominated record must be explained completely by the same key. No rolling-window search, unlabeled local triangles, arbitrary diagram subset or residual prose may count. Exact physical record boundaries, positions and orientation must be established independently before any key search; none is currently established. A corpus-wide sixteen-token cipher is expressly not proposed.
design.semantics: The current operational endpoint is sixteen externally named binary figures in fixed computational roles. The historical text also assigns different contextual significations by house. A figure and house do not select a unique question, individual referent or natural-language sentence. No illness, plant, person or other named subject is inferred without a separately observed source-defined selector. Thus even a uniquely reconstructed arithmetic register would support a conditional formal reading, not a complete natural-language translation.
design.contrast: This is coupled computation over complete records, unlike the closed f57v/Cod.Sang.756 local inventory comparison and unlike GDT891 vegetative captions or IDEA000128 ordered Llull chambers. Arithmetic alone is insufficient: XOR admits all20160 invertible F_2-linear figure relabelings. But a relabeling phi(x)=Ax preserving the same fixed mother/daughter transposition for every M must obey A M^T=M^T A^T for every binary4x4 matrix. Taking identity gives A=A^T, and commuting with every matrix gives A=lambda I; invertibility overF2 gives A=I. Therefore the ideal full two-operation language has no nontrivial global figure relabeling with fixed roles. A finite observed sample can still have many keys; unobserved values and alternative orientations remain unknown. This mathematical observation is not an empirical identifiability result.
design.prediction: After source and target contracts are separately fixed, freeze all keys on complete discovery records. In a wholly held record disclose only its four input tokens after the key lock, then predict all eleven remaining complete tokens under every surviving key before reading them. Missing input or output code values yield UNKNOWN, not fitted completions. Unanimous full output prediction is required for an identified conditional register reading. It supplies no independent meaning score or GDT388 pass.
design.algorithm: No implementation selected. The source program has exactly16^4=65536 input assignments and complete outputs. A finite checker can compare every complete target record against every source output using forward/reverse token equality, then jointly solve all resulting key constraints and project over all solutions. Source-independent necessary checks include at most16 distinct figure tokens, complete fifteen-field scope, and even Hamming weight of the judge. The latter follows because the sum of all row parities equals the sum of all column parities. None of these checks licenses scanning for favorable target windows. Source counts or uniqueness under the full65536-family do not prove adequate finite target diversity.
design.rank_blocker: For any fixed spelling assigned to each of sixteen figures, every wholly covered literal line count vector is M z_l+b, with M having at most16 columns and b one fixed line framing count. Line differences have rank<=16, regardless of spelling length, injectivity or prefix freedom. GDT882 certifies rank20 on its declared scope, excluding this fixed-code explanation whenever all its certificate lines are covered. A narrower complete-register domain cannot inherit that exclusion without its own scope/rank proof. Do not expand the figure alphabet or add contextual spelling to rescue the excluded model.
design.source: Primary operational text consulted: Robert Turner1655, Of Geomancy, attributed there to Agrippa but identified by the institutional editor as pseudo-Agrippa; complete transcription https://www.princeton.edu/~ezb/geomancy/agrippa.html . The passage beginning with the four Matres gives the common derivation, followed by an explicitly different preferred house arrangement; these must not be fused. The page preserves alternate correspondences and contextual interpretations, so no timeless universal semantic table is assumed. Direct cache retrieval returnedHTTP403; the browser rendered the text. Historical early presence only: British Museum object1888,0526.1, Muhammad ibn Khutlukh al-Mawsili,1241-1242, https://www.britishmuseum.org/collection/object/W_1888-0526-1 ; its catalog does not itself certify this complete program. BL Sloane314,1425-1449, geomancyff2r-64v, https://searcharchives.bl.uk/catalog/040-002112660 ; catalog reports digital images unavailable. Neither early item has been fully collated here. An early complete rule/name/house/serialization witness remains a source gate, not an established input.

Decision-changing outcomes, only after both gates: no key excludes the exact complete-register law; multiple keys leave formal values unidentified; all-key agreement plus exact held continuation supports only the conditional operational reading.
